Projects.persona: Project managers and scoped business users
read: Project register with active contracts and renewal attention
Project facts, products, environments and contracts

read: Manually reported condition and review freshness
Applications, servers, work, firewall, condition history, quality, files and history tabs
Environments.guard: Environments resource and tab rights; detail requires DetailsView; condition reports do not constitute live monitoring or inventory review.

Installations and versions.guard: Installations:View and detail rights; version matrix uses Installations:View; components map to Servers rights.

read: Asset register filters and aggregate CPU/RAM/storage totals

Firewall rules.guard: OtherOperations rights plus Platform:TechnicalDetail. This is recorded configuration, not a live firewall export.

Products and microservices.persona: Product owners, developers and support engineers
Products and microservices.guard: Products resource rights; in-use entities are generally retired rather than deleted; UI canEdit/canDelete are hints backed by API checks.

Tickets.persona: Operation engineers, incident coordinators and managers
read: All-ticket search including client and Jira key
Activity, affected records, Jira references, documented impact, commitments, escalations, files, field history
write: Sync with Jira (external read and local writes)
Tickets.guard: Cases and per-tab rights; detail rights separate. Jira-synchronized status/priority/due dates/first response follow Jira rules; do not expect manual incident lifecycle actions on those tickets.

Commitments.guard: Commitments resource rights; waiting never pauses deadlines; late completion remains Completed with a separate timeliness result.

Personal notes.persona: Signed-in permitted users; own notes only
write: GET /notes/tree creates starter notebook/section when absent
Personal notes.guard: PersonalNotes rights; every record is owner-only. Avoid opening unprovisioned live accounts: nominal read has initialization writes.

Escalations.guard: OtherOperations resource rights; channels configurable; hub records communications and does not send them.

Teams and handovers.persona: Team leads, managers and receiving owners
Teams and handovers.guard: Teams rights plus Handovers/Reassignment view rights. Capacity and absence planning explicitly remain future scope.

Reporting Center.persona: Permitted report consumers and managers with Export
Reporting Center.guard: Platform:Export plus area-specific ReportOverview/Library/Builder/SavedReports/ReportSchedules/History/Templates View; report/data rights checked separately. Export itself is not a pure read.

Users, roles and access.guard: Platform:Administration plus area rights; AdminRoute wraps admin screens; audit/archived exceptions use dedicated rights. Group mappings hidden in Forms mode.

Configuration and settings.guard: Administration plus AdminConfig/AdminSettings rights. Never change any production setting for audit; settings may move stored attachment files.

Jira integrations.guard: Administration plus AdminIntegrations rights. Connection tests/previews/sync contact Jira and may write local state. Do not trigger in live audit.

Change history and archive.guard: AdminAudit and Platform:Audit appropriately scoped; archived page needs any ArchiveRestore right and per-record API access. No production restore/delete testing.
